title: Aeta communities in Bataan reject mining deal in ancestral land

blocks.text: OLONGAPO CITY, ZAMBALES, Philippines — After years of opposing mining exploration in their ancestral domain, the Aeta Magbukon communities in nearby Bataan province secured a temporary halt to exploration activities in Mt. Pantingan and are now pressing to cancel the mining agreement covering the area. The Mines and Geosciences Bureau (MGB) in Central Luzon ordered Balanga Bataan Minerals Corp. (BBMC) on Nov. 9 to temporarily stop all exploration activities under Mineral Production Sharing Agreement (MPSA) No. 154-2000-III. According to the MGB, the order followed a technical conference on Oct. 29, during which Aeta representatives raised concerns over the free, prior and […]...
